answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Lattice: each identity must solve a fresh, instance-bound puzzle whose answer is the unique preimage of a seed derived from the prior block plus that agent’s grove of prior outputs; answers are consumed once and never reused. Verification checks the preimage against the seed before granting standing. Near the horizon, difficulty retunes so flooding costs scale with attempts. Any ripple of duplicated answers voids all linked identities. An attacker therefore pays a distinct compute-and-storage cost per identity, with no amortization across clones.
